The '''Shaymore system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]].
